# Latent Variable Models in Ecology and their Inference via the EM Algorithm and its Extensions — Codes and Data.  {.unlisted}

![Book cover](/images/illustration_bookcover.png){width=50%}

This repository hosts the **codes and data** accompanying the book
*Latent variable models for ecology with the EM algorithm*, by
[Sophie Donnet](https://sophiedonnet.github.io/),
[Pierre Gloaguen]() and [Stéphane Robin](https://scj-robin.github.io/).

The philosophy of the book is described on the companion
[book website](https://lvme-with-em-book.github.io/), where the methodological
chapters are presented.

## Chapters

The illustrative data analyses, chapter by chapter:

- **Chapter 2 — Latent variable models and the EM algorithm.** The EM algorithm in action on a two-component Gaussian mixture ([bill length of Palmer penguins](Codes/02_MixtureAdelie/Chap2_EM_toy_mixture.html)).
- **Chapter 5 — Approximate E-step.** Variational EM for a Stochastic Block Model fitted to a fungus–tree interaction network ([data analysis](Codes/05_SBM_LBM/Chap5_SBM_Application.html)).
- **Chapter 6 — Stochastic E-step.** SAEM-MCMC estimation for the Live Fuel Moisture Content data ([data analysis](Codes/06_NonLinearMIxedEffects/Chap6_SAEM_MCMC_LFMC.html)).

## Organisation of the repository

```
Codes/
  02_MixtureAdelie/       Chap. 2 - EM on a Gaussian mixture (Penguins)
  05_SBM_LBM/             Chap. 5 - Variational EM / Stochastic Block Model
  06_NonLinearMIxedEffects/  Chap. 6 - SAEM-MCMC
  Functions/              shared helper functions
  utils_*.R               shared plotting utilities
Data/                     data files used by the chapters
```
